title: Multi-Armed Occult Goddess
description: A multi-armed female deity with pale skin and closed eyes sits in a meditative lotus pose atop a mound of dark earth and scattered beetles. She holds open books, a coiled snake, and ritual objects in her many hands while wearing ornate robes and an elaborate headdress, surrounded by glowing candles and golden rings against a dark background.
prompt: A serene multi-armed female deity with pale skin and closed eyes sits cross-legged in lotus pose on a mound of dark soil covered in beetles and insects. She has six visible arms holding open books with symbols, a coiled snake, and ritual objects, wearing intricate patterned robes, golden jewelry, and an elaborate headdress with circular motifs. Dark mystical background with floating glowing golden rings and lit candles, high contrast black and white with gold accents, detailed linework, occult atmosphere.
